name: Hotel Frohnatur
beschreibung: Hotel Frohnatur is nestled in the idyllic municipality of Thiersee close to Kufstein. The alpine surroundings feature tranquil nature near the lake and scenic vistas of the Zahmer Kaiser and Wilder Kaiser peaks. Cross-country trails, winter walks, and alpine hiking paths are readily accessible. Property features include comfortable rooms with private balconies, a relaxing sauna area, and an on-site restaurant serving hearty regional specialties.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Frohnatur in Thiersee offers peaceful lakeside hospitality, sauna facilities, mountain-view balconies, and quick access to Kaisergebirge ski and hiking routes.
